name: Isotretinoin
description: A retinoic acid isomer approved for severe recalcitrant nodular acne. Carries a boxed warning for extreme teratogenicity and is dispensed only through the iPLEDGE risk management programme.

systems.note: Sebaceous gland suppression; the labelled dermatological indication.
Transaminase elevation is labelled and monitoring is required by labelling.
Marked triglyceride and cholesterol elevation is labelled.
Depression, psychosis and pseudotumour cerebri appear in labelling.
Bone density effects and hyperostosis are labelled with prolonged use.
Alopecia, in some cases persistent, and other hair abnormalities are labelled under skin and appendages.

monitors.why: Marked elevation is labelled and is one of the two required monitoring parameters.
Labelled transaminase elevation with required monitoring.
